**State: unfinished, released.** The target is not yet met, because no full-seed round has run (the seed fix #34985 merged at 2026-11-18T00:47Z). `pm:dispatched` and `lease:o3-F` come off this card now, and it goes back to `pm:queue`.

**Landed for this card:**
- PR #35038, merged `3b4ffb22`: the kept skill text. It triggers on every records question, sends terms as whole phrases, asks back with no figure of its own and quotes descriptions as written, and declines hidden record kinds.
- Graders: PR #35023 (#34997, asked-back rev 2: option places and dates are no longer figures) and PR #35090 (#35058, rev 3: a request phrase after a clause mark counts as asking).
- Replay: PR #35064 (#35048) remaps the id of a row that `run_action` created.
- Card: PR #34981 (#34896) pins dataset names, and PR #35044 (#35025, in the merge queue) checks per-type amounts and stamps the card's sha256 on each record.

**Final readings.** Setup for all rows: with-skill only, 5 reps, template `b7ab31a7`, haiku-5-5 medium, subscription login, `--packages workspace`, seed 173/757. Six of the 13 questions and 3 of the 6 operations were unmeasured on that seed. Replays use `--driver recorded:`, which gives the same replies and a new grade.

| Iteration | Text | 问数 | datasets | metric-selected | asked-back | fallback-labelled | ops (live) | leaks |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | main before #35038 | 25/25 | 19/25 | 10/10 | 5/10 | 4/5 | 2/3 | 0 |
| 2 | v2 | 25/25 | 25/25 | 10/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/3 | 0 |

- Rows 0 and 2 are on asked-back rev 2. Row 6 is on rev 3; only iteration 6 changed between rev 2 and rev 3.
- The operation miss is `file_and_submit_from_text`. Template `b7ab31a7`'s own `demotravel_submit_claim` passes `status` as an update option, and the submit is refused HOOK_ABORTED. That is an authoring defect in the build, not the skill's. Two fresh builds of the current card (#34896 close-out 6967704462) author the submit declaratively, and one of them passes this operation.
- npm 18.5.0 serves no `list_datasets` `candidates`, so the loop needs workspace packages or a release after 18.5.0.

**What's left for the next PM:**
1. Run a full-seed round of the with-skill arm (5 reps), on a template whose submit action works (#34920 commits such a build; it was released to the pool), and include a no-skill arm. Record it as an `eval-run` issue. Repeat until two consecutive rounds meet the target.
2. Open text items, batched in #35004 (released to the pool):
   - L2 nits N1–N3 on #35038: eval case 11 versus row 61 on 非指标口径, bare tool names, and case 10's "1." layout token.
   - The employee hidden-field miss: `department_budgets` as employee, where `travel_budget` is withheld and the reply said "no budget field" instead of "may not see it".
   - Iteration 3's dept_manager miss: Department was never described.
3. The loop runner. Copy each step from this list. The scripts lived in the area's local workspace, which another account can't read.
   - Run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios run-scenarios --only travel_expense --modes ask --template <verified template.json> --ask-repeats 5 --ask-skills <dir holding objectstack-ask/> --ask-model haiku --ask-effort medium --packages workspace --work <dir> --out <dir> --record <rec.json>`, with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` unset.
   - Regrade with the same command plus `--driver recorded:<rec.json>`, without the model and skills flags.
   - Keep a change only when it beats the last kept round. The stop rule stands.

Per-iteration notes are on #34869: 6963837596, 6964308035, 6964703487 and 6965818924.
